title.narrative: Performance Monitoring of Local Authorities to Strengthen Public Oversight, Accountability & Expenditure Management IDF Grant

description.narrative: The purposes of the Grant are to assist the Recipient in: (i) strengthening the public oversight of the public funds allocated to Turkey's local governments sector every year; (ii) improving the public accountability of the local authorities; and (iii) assisting governments' efforts to formulate actions to improve the sector's public expenditure management.
